route.title: Relay route
route.description: Variable-map relay signals to energise (close) before the test, e.g. ["hipot_route_pri_sec"]. All are opened again after. Empty = test with no relay change.

action.title: Hipot tester action
action.description: Variable-map action bound to the safety_tester capability (maps/st1.json "actions"). Default matches this bench's "hipot" binding.

step.title: Tester program step
step.description: Which of the tester's stored program steps (FUNC:STEP, 1-20) to program and run. The step must already exist on the instrument; this only sets its type/voltage/dwell time, not the total step count.

voltage.title: AC withstand voltage (V)
voltage.description: RMS test voltage applied between the two routed points. From the product spec / recipe — not invented. Instrument range 50-5000 V.

test_time.title: Test (dwell) time (s)
test_time.description: How long the withstand voltage is held once risen, before falling. From the product spec / recipe — not invented.

max_current_ma.title: Max leakage current (mA)
max_current_ma.description: Upper acceptance limit for AC leakage current. From the product spec / recipe — not invented.

settle_s.title: Settle time (s)
settle_s.description: Dwell after closing the route before starting the test (relay operate time).

name.title: Measurement name
name.description: Base name recorded for the measurements (defaults to "leakage_current"; a "_breakdown" suffix names the dielectric-fault flag).
